classifications.rationale: The President presently modifies the scope of an existing national emergency; the legal change occurs in this segment upon issuance.
classifications.evidence: hereby modify the scope of the national emergency

classifications.rationale: The President makes the operative national-emergency threat determination in this segment, a present statutory determination with legal significance.
classifications.evidence: constitute an unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security and foreign policy of the United States

classifications.rationale: The President presently blocks covered persons’ property and prohibits dealing in it once Treasury determines that a person meets the stated criteria.
classifications.evidence: All property and interests in property that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any United States person, including any foreign branch, of the following persons are blocked

classifications.rationale: The President amends earlier sanctions criteria that Treasury will apply in making later blocking determinations, thereby dictating the scope of later agency-administered legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: by removing "logistical, or technical" in section 1(b)(ii) and replacing it with "or technological"

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory impairment determination concerning specified donations; the determination itself occurs in this segment.
classifications.evidence: I hereby determine that the making of donations of the type of articles specified in section 203(b)(2) of IEEPA

classifications.rationale: The President presently prohibits specified donations, contributions, provisions, and receipts; the legal restrictions arise directly from this segment.
classifications.evidence: I hereby prohibit such donations as provided by section 1 of this order

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory detriment finding concerning entry by the covered aliens; the determination itself occurs here.
classifications.evidence: would be detrimental to the interests of the United States

classifications.rationale: The President directly suspends covered aliens’ entry, creates an official-business exception, and prohibits evasion and conspiracy; these legal consequences arise from the segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I hereby suspend entry into the United States, as immigrants or nonimmigrants, of such persons

classifications.rationale: The President makes an explanatory factual finding about the practical effect of prior notice, but this segment alone neither removes notice nor changes a legal right or duty.
classifications.evidence: prior notice to such persons of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would render those measures ineffectual

classifications.rationale: The President presently determines that no prior notice is required for covered listings or determinations, directly altering the applicable procedure.
classifications.evidence: there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to section 1 of this order

classifications.rationale: This is only a section heading and contains no operative presidential governance or legal consequence.
The President delegates implementation and rulemaking authority to Treasury and permits redelegation without dictating a particular later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations

classifications.rationale: The President directs agencies to undertake appropriate implementation within existing authority and adds a standard non-creation-of-rights disclaimer; this is implementation housekeeping rather than a specified legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: All agencies of the United States Government are hereby directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority
